p1: I'll never ride my building's elevator again. Not after what answered the help button.
I work night shift at the hospital. Every morning, I take that elevator down alone.
Dark hallways, mirrors on every wall... it always felt like someone was in there with me.
Yesterday, the hallway lights were flickering. But I was running late, so I got in.
As the lights went out, I saw it in the mirror. Something standing right behind me.
I hit the help button. A woman answered.
I told her what I saw. Then she asked...
So who's going to save you? I know you saw me.
I said, what did you just say?
I got my phone light on and spun around.
The elevator started again. I ran.
I haven't used it since. I'm moving out. Even the stairs scare me now.
